path_policy: No external hardcoded path. Data dir is CLI argument or current/script relative auto-detection. Results are written under Path.cwd() unless --out-dir is provided.

resource_profile.reason: Designed to run alongside long_max, short_main and short_max without multiplying process count.

baseline_entry_source: Embedded current long_main v4: v1 raw_l01_cap_reclaim + double_flush_ok + vol>=1.45 + body_atr<=2.20 + ret20<=-0.08 + TP03. Extra cp>=0.77 is not part of v4.
v9_focus: Resource-aware structural improvement around v4. Default workers=1 and fewer variants to avoid CPU/RAM overload when long_main, long_max, short_main, short_max are run together. Tests MDD defense, reclaim_atr loose caps, shock freshness, volume/body structural variants. No MFE/MAE future-info filters.
